info.name: AIHomeManager API
info.description: Kolekcja Postman/Newman dla AIHomeManager REST API. Base URL: http://localhost:8080/api. Tasks CRUD (POST/GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE single) pominiete — endpointy nie zaimplementowane (HMAI-43); zostal tylko /tasks/time-report. Music endpointy moga zwracac 503 gdy brak realnych kluczy Last.fm/Discogs w .env.local. Books ISBN-aware testy toleruja 503 gdy BN API jest nieosiagalne z kontenera.

exec: pm.test('Has ID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('series_id', body.id); });

pm.test('Has title and seasons', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('seasons'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('averageRating'); });
pm.test('Has season ID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('season_id', body.id); });
pm.test('Has episode ID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('episode_id', body.id); });

item.name: Tasks
item.description: Tylko /tasks/time-report i /tasks/export — CRUD endpointy (POST/GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) nie istnieja (HMAI-43)

exec: pm.test('Has totalMinutes and totalHours', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalMinutes'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalHours'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('breakdown'); });

pm.test('Content-Type text/csv with utf-8 charset', () => { const ct = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || ''; pm.expect(ct).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(ct.toLowerCase()).to.include('utf-8'); });
pm.test('Body starts with CSV header row', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('title,startTime,endTime'));
pm.test('Body starts with PDF magic bytes', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text().substring(0, 5)).to.equal('%PDF-'));

item.name: Books
item.description: Biblioteka ksiazek. POST po ISBN wymaga National Library API — toleruje 503 gdy nieosiagalne.

exec: pm.test('All books have status reading', () => { const books = pm.response.json(); books.forEach(b => pm.expect(b.status).to.equal('reading')); });

if (pm.response.code === 201) { pm.test('Returns created book id', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('book_id', body.id); }); }
pm.test('Status 422 lub 503 (walidacja ISBN albo BN API)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([422, 503]));
pm.test('Has reading progress fields', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('percentage'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('currentPage'); });
pm.test('Has metadata from BN API', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('author'); });

pm.test('Content-Type text/csv with utf-8 charset', () => { const ct = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || ''; pm.expect(ct).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(ct.toLowerCase()).to.include('utf-8'); });
pm.test('Body starts with CSV header row', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('isbn,title,author'));
pm.test('Body starts with PDF magic bytes', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text().substring(0, 5)).to.equal('%PDF-'));

item.name: Music
item.description: Last.fm / Discogs — toleruja 503 gdy w .env.local brak realnych kluczy

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Returns albums array', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(body)).to.be.true; }); }

if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Has all four sections', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('ownedAndListened'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('wantList'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('dustyShelf'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('matchScore'); pm.expect(body.matchScore).to.be.within(0, 100); }); }
pm.test('Contains posted manual session', () => { const titles = pm.response.json().map(s => s.title); pm.expect(titles).to.include('Smoke Test Album'); });
pm.test('Has ID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('article_id', body.id); });

pm.test('Has article data', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('url'); pm.collectionVariables.set('today_article_id', body.id); });

item.name: GET - Artykul na dzis (2 - cache check)

exec: pm.test('Same article as previous (cache idempotent)', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('today_article_id')); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Inny artykul (cache invalidated)', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.not.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('today_article_id')); }); }

pm.test('Content-Type text/csv with utf-8 charset', () => { const ct = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || ''; pm.expect(ct).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(ct.toLowerCase()).to.include('utf-8'); });
pm.test('Body starts with CSV header row', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('title,url'));
pm.test('Body starts with PDF magic bytes', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text().substring(0, 5)).to.equal('%PDF-'));

item.name: YouTubeProgress
item.description: Panel watchlisty YT z auto-podzialem na sesje 30-min. POST /sync wymaga realnego YouTube OAuth (w test env playlist ID jest ustawione, wiec sync uderzylby w API) — pominiety w smoke. Testowane deterministyczne sciezki: read (watchlist/sessions) + 404 dla nieistniejacych encji.

exec: pm.test('Has videos array', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('videos'); pm.expect(Array.isArray(body.videos)).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Has sessions array', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('sessions'); pm.expect(Array.isArray(body.sessions)).to.be.true; });

item.name: POST - Oznacz nieistniejacy film jako rozpoczety (404)
Budget
item.description: Modul finansow domowych: transakcje, kategorie z limitami miesiecznymi, raport miesieczny i eksport CSV/PDF. Scenariusz jest sekwencyjny (kategoria -> transakcja -> limit -> raport -> eksporty -> sprzatanie), wiec `make test-newman` czysci tabele budget_* przed uruchomieniem.

exec: pm.test('Has ID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('budget_category_id', body.id); });
pm.test('Status 409 dla duplikatu nazwy w tym samym typie', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test('Has ID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('budget_transaction_id', body.id); });

pm.test('Zawiera dodana transakcje z kwota w groszach', () => { const tx = pm.response.json().find(t => t.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('budget_transaction_id')); pm.expect(tx).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(tx.amountInCents).to.equal(15000); pm.expect(tx.currency).to.equal('PLN'); });
pm.test('Status 422 gdy podano tylko kwote bez waluty', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

pm.test('Ma sumy i rozbicie na kategorie', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('month', '2026-07'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalIncomeInCents'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('totalExpensesInCents'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('balanceInCents'); pm.expect(Array.isArray(body.categories)).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Kategoria po przekroczeniu limitu ma overLimit=true', () => { const row = pm.response.json().categories.find(c => c.categoryId === pm.collectionVariables.get('budget_category_id')); pm.expect(row).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(row.spentInCents).to.equal(15000); pm.expect(row.monthlyLimitInCents).to.equal(10000); pm.expect(row.overLimit).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Content-Type text/csv with utf-8 charset', () => { const ct = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || ''; pm.expect(ct).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(ct.toLowerCase()).to.include('utf-8'); });
pm.test('Body starts with CSV header row', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('date,category,type,amount,currency,description'));
pm.test('Kwota w jednostkach dziesietnych, nie w groszach', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.include('150.00'); pm.expect(text).to.include('Newman Zakupy'); });
pm.test('Body starts with PDF magic bytes', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text().substring(0, 5)).to.equal('%PDF-'));
pm.test('Body starts with CSV header row', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('category,type,spent,monthlyLimit,limitCurrency,percentUsed,overLimit'));

pm.test('Przekroczony limit oznaczony flaga 1', () => { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).to.include('Newman Zakupy'); pm.expect(text).to.include(',expense,150.00,100.00,PLN,150.00,1'); });
pm.test('Body starts with PDF magic bytes', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text().substring(0, 5)).to.equal('%PDF-'));
pm.test('Status 409 - historia ksiegowa nie znika po cichu', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test('Status 204 po usunieciu ostatniej transakcji', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));

item.name: Recipes
item.description: Modul kulinarny: katalog przepisow, tygodniowy kalendarz planu posilkow, lista zakupow i jej eksport. Scenariusz jest sekwencyjny (przepis -> plan -> lista -> eksporty -> sprzatanie), wiec `make test-newman` czysci tabele recipes*/meal_plan przed uruchomieniem.

exec: pm.test('Has ID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('recipe_id', body.id); });
pm.test('Status 422 - przepis musi miec co najmniej jeden skladnik', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('Tag dopasowany bez wzgledu na wielkosc liter', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty);

pm.test('Lista niesie licznik skladnikow, nie same skladniki', () => { const r = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(r).to.have.property('ingredientCount', 2); pm.expect(r).to.not.have.property('ingredients'); });

pm.test('Szczegoly sa splaszczone - przepis na wierzchu, bez klucza recipe', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(body).to.not.have.property('recipe'); });

pm.test('Skladniki i kroki w zapisanej kolejnosci', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.ingredients.map(i => i.name)).to.eql(['Maka', 'Jajko']); pm.expect(body.steps).to.eql(['Wymieszaj', 'Usmaz']); });
pm.test('Status 422 - servings sa wymagane przy pelnej podmianie, bo lista zakupow skaluje sie porcjami', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('Has ID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('id'); pm.collectionVariables.set('meal_id', body.id); });

item.name: POST - Ten sam przepis w tym samym slocie (409)

exec: pm.test('Status 409 - ten sam przepis dwa razy w jednym slocie', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test('Status 404 - brak przepisu sprawdzany przed konfliktem slotu', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('Okno odbite w odpowiedzi', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.from).to.eql('2026-08-03'); pm.expect(body.to).to.eql('2026-08-09'); });
pm.test('Kazdy dzien okna obecny, takze pusty', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().days).to.have.lengthOf(7));

pm.test('Kazdy dzien niesie cztery sloty w kolejnosci doby', () => { const slots = pm.response.json().days[0].slots.map(s => s.slot); pm.expect(slots).to.eql(['breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', 'snack']); });
pm.test('Status 422 - okno jest wymagane, nie domyslane', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('Status 422 - 31 lutego odrzucony, nie przewiniety na marzec', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

pm.test('Ilosci przeskalowane z 4 porcji przepisu na 5 zaplanowanych', () => { const maka = pm.response.json().items.find(i => i.name === 'Maka'); pm.expect(maka.quantity).to.be.closeTo(625, 0.001); });

pm.test('JSON niesie surowa sume - zaokraglanie jest sprawa prezentacji', () => { const jajko = pm.response.json().items.find(i => i.name === 'Jajko'); pm.expect(jajko.quantity).to.be.closeTo(2.5, 0.001); pm.expect(jajko.unit).to.eql('piece'); });

pm.test('Content-Type text/csv with utf-8 charset', () => { const ct = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type') || ''; pm.expect(ct).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(ct.toLowerCase()).to.include('utf-8'); });
pm.test('Nazwa pliku niesie okno, wiec trzy tygodnie to trzy rozne pliki', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Disposition')).to.include('shopping-list-2026-08-03_2026-08-09.csv'));
pm.test('Body starts with CSV header row', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('name,unit,quantity'));
pm.test('2.5 jajka zaokraglone w gore do 3, nie w dol do 2', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include(',piece,3'));
pm.test('Body starts with PDF magic bytes', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text().substring(0, 5)).to.equal('%PDF-'));
pm.test('Status 422 - nieznany format odrzucony, nie cofniety po cichu do CSV', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('Status 409 - przepis uzyty w planie nie znika razem z nim', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test('Status 204 - zwolniony przepis daje sie usunac', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));

item.name: Auth
item.description: OAuth endpointy (poza firewallem /api). Newman musi byc uruchomiony z --ignore-redirects, inaczej HTTP klient policzy 200 z accounts.google.com zamiast 302 z naszej aplikacji.

exec: pm.test('Location zawiera accounts.google.com', () => { const loc = pm.response.headers.get('Location') || ''; pm.expect(loc).to.include('accounts.google.com'); });
if (pm.response.code === 302) { pm.test('Location zawiera discogs.com', () => { const loc = pm.response.headers.get('Location') || ''; pm.expect(loc).to.include('discogs.com'); }); }
